summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by Prudential plc, the foreign private issuer, reporting its total voting rights and issued share capital as of June 30, 2026 under UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. It states 2,511,004,470 ordinary shares outstanding, no treasury shares, and the corresponding total voting rights. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, or other special-situation elements. This is a standard periodic disclosure with no bearing on any restructuring, deal, or strategic review.
